explication: A2A is an interoperability protocol, not a server implementation in this repository. Its principal workflow is an agent client discovering another agent’s card, then exchanging task-oriented messages with that agent using a supported protocol binding. The graph captures protocol-defined capabilities; the available excerpts do not show runtime dispatch, storage, or transport implementations.
